author: Hasegawa, Tsuyoshi
title: The February Revolution: Petrograd, 1917
notes: The fullest reconstruction of the nine days of February, arguing that the monarchy fell to an insurrection of workers and soldiers that no party organised and that the liberal politicians then scrambled to contain by inventing dual power. An expanded edition appeared as The February Revolution, Petrograd, 1917: The End of the Tsarist Regime and the Birth of Dual Power (Brill, 2017, Historical Materialism Book Series 149) — pages do not carry between the two. Borrow-only; cited without pages.
